remarks: Location dream! Charming Colonial styled split level home is picture perfect in sought after neighborhood with newly paved sidewalks to schools, YMCA, Waveny Park and town! This well cared for home lives large with over 2200SF and an open concept flow. Sunny and spacious Living and Dining areas open to a fabulous screened porch and deck overlooking the manicured yard. Enjoy mature landscaping and room for playscapes and lawn games. The bay window and wood-burning fireplace are the focal points in the Living Room and the Dining area opens to Kitchen with custom wood cabinets, Viking gas cooktop & stainless appliances. A main floor family room is convenient with laundry room and access to garage while the lower level media room w/closet can be additional guest area, playroom or office. Hardwood floors throughout offer a contemporary feel. The spacious upstairs Primary Suite has walk-in closet, full bath and opens to an upper level deck. Two other good sized bedrooms and full bath across the hall. Extra deep two car garage and large parking area in driveway allows plenty of space for a bball hoop! Town water and sewer and natural gas hook-up in street for easy switch if desired as well as expansion possibilities make this home a great opportunity. Being sold as is. Tenants are currently in place, Showing appts required.
